_about: One slot, one ID. Every image slot with its source and status. Homes and destinations use Escape Away’s own photos from its Airbnb listings (status original, file in photos/). The Seaside and Family collection tiles and the three owner-journey steps use stock photos (status stock, credited in the footer) chosen as mood photos; never present a stock photo as a real unit.
